name: Komagane (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Komagane city emblem in navy: a disc bearing a white stylised mountain of two peaks.
history: Municipal flag of Komagane, a city in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 August 1961; the emblem dates from 1 July 1954.

features.role: Komagane city emblem — a disc bearing a white stylised mountain of two peaks
